description: Architecting a modular, versioned FastAPI product layer around speech AI and conversational processing pipelines (NimbleBiz), adding stateless authentication, multi-tenant isolation, rate limiting, and telemetry monitoring.
responsibilities: Architected and deployed a versioned FastAPI product layer around speech AI and conversational inference pipelines without modifying core processing engines.
Implemented stateless JWT authentication (register/login/me) with bcrypt password hashing and strict multi-tenant account-scoped data isolation.
Engineered in-memory sliding-window rate limiters and per-account upload quotas to ensure API reliability and protect compute resources.
Built account-scoped usage telemetry endpoints tracking audio duration, processing latencies, and service metrics exposed via authenticated APIs.
Configured automated OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, Pydantic validation schemas, and structured error handling for frontend client consumption.
achievements: Engineered modular v1 REST API layer with automated OpenAPI and Swagger interactive documentation.
Enforced multi-tenant data isolation, rejecting unauthorized cross-account requests and verifying permission boundaries.
Implemented sliding-window rate limiters and quota enforcement to protect downstream AI inference pipelines.
Integrated account-scoped telemetry monitoring processing latency, audio duration, and system resource utilization.
